2. CORE AUTOMATION PRINCIPLES (No-Human-Touch Goals)
• Event-driven architecture using webhooks and real-time bi-directional sync with operating systems
• Zero manual journal entries for recurring, rule-based, or IC transactions
• Protected Commission Liability buckets — money is automatically moved on invoice payment and cannot be spent from operating cash
• Bank Feeds + Credit Card Feeds with AI categorization, receipt matching, and exception-only review
• Automatic customer/invoice creation + de-dupe when sales occur in entity portals
• Paid status callback instantly updates AR, commissions, cash forecast, and dashboards
• Continuous close (daily/weekly automated) instead of traditional month-end
• Full data lineage and immutable audit trail on every number
• Vendor self-service portal for invoice submission + automated I-9/W-9/1099 collection
• Loan amortization engine that automatically posts interest/principal and models extra payments live
3. LOAN MANAGEMENT MODULE (New Requirement)
Supported Loan Types: Term Loans, Lines of Credit, Equipment Financing, Convertible Notes, Related-Party Loans, Shareholder Loans, SBA, etc.
Core Features:
- Full amortization schedule generation (monthly/quarterly)
- Interactive extra/additional payment simulator — instantly shows impact on remaining balance, total interest, and payoff date
- Automatic journal entries for interest expense and principal reduction
- Multiple loans per entity with consolidated view
- Integration into Cash Flow Forecast and Liability section of Balance Sheet
- Alerts for upcoming payments, covenants, maturity
- What-if scenarios for refinancing or accelerated payoff
